summary: Log bird sightings anywhere and build your life list.
page_description: A field-ready eBird companion for quick sightings, species lookup, life lists, and checklist sharing.
release_notes: A species page leads with its name, with the scientific name and banding code on one line under it, and has a single Back.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Make a field pack from a CSV list of birds, such as your eBird data download.
steps.command: kobo fieldbook new MyEBirdData.csv --title "Local birds" --out pack.json

steps.text: Send the pack. Each push adds packs; the ones already there stay.
Later, bring your outings back as an eBird checklist.
